in_marathi.name: Asok
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asok हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asok means 'without sorrow' in Sanskrit. This name is derived from the Ashoka tree, which symbolizes strength, courage, and resilience. In Hindu mythology, Asoka was the name of a great emperor known for his wisdom, kindness, and conquest of the entire Indian subcontinent.
